title: Sunburn Beach Arena Goa 2025
excerpt: A legendary sunset-to-midnight seaside journey with 55,000 festivalgoers and the live debut of Dj G-Spark's signature festival anthems.
description: Performing on the main stage as dusk settled over the Arabian Sea, Dj G-Spark delivered a 3.5-hour masterclass in progressive melodic techno and high-energy bass. Over 200 pyro drones coordinated above the crowd, syncing with the bass drops.
highlights: Premiere of 'Ignite The Night' Live VIP Mix
tracklist: 01. Dj G-Spark - Feel The Spark (Intro VIP)

title: Delhi Arena Homecoming Showcase 2024
excerpt: A triumphant sold-out arena homecoming show celebrating Dj G-Spark's decade of electronic and Bollywood mastery.
description: 28,000 die-hard fans packed the IGI Stadium for a non-stop 4-hour musical journey with full stadium pyrotechnics, moving truss ceiling, and live dhol collaboration.
highlights: Sold out arena crowd in the capital
tracklist: 02. Dj G-Spark - Royal Bassline & Dhol Sync
03. Dj G-Spark - Pulse of the Capital

title: Udaipur Royal Sangeet & Afterparty 2024
excerpt: An ultra-luxury palace destination wedding featuring custom video mapping, retro Bollywood remixes, and an unforgettable 5-hour high energy party set.
description: Set overlooking Lake Pichola, Dj G-Spark electrified the grand royal sangeet celebration with seamless transitions from vintage 90s Bollywood to modern high-energy Punjabi and commercial dance anthems that kept the dance floor packed until 4:00 AM.
highlights: Live LED dhol and percussion accompaniment
Custom acoustic calibration for lakeside heritage palace
tracklist: 03. Dj G-Spark - Late Night Punjabi Bollytech

title: Mumbai Dome Live Electronic Showcase 2024
excerpt: Massive indoor sensory show in Mumbai with synchronized moving lights, heavy driving basslines, and unreleased festival anthems.
description: A packed NSCI Dome witnessed Dj G-Spark's signature hybrid set bridging commercial Bollywood vocals with club-shaking electronic drops, backed by a 60-meter curved LED visual wall.
tracklist: 03. Dj G-Spark - Commercial Anthems Live Mashup
